description: This file contains test cases for HTTP server behaviors using pytest, including file download and upload tests over multiple protocols and configurations within a Caddy server environment.

classes.name: TestCaddy
classes.description: Pytest test class for testing Caddy server with various HTTP download and upload scenarios
